name: Purum (Retired)
credit: Compiled by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) for András Kornai
statement: I decline puz. It is a retired ISO 639-3 code ("Purum (Retired)", bookkeeping, no family), merged into pub (Purum) in 2014 (change request 2013-008). It is not a separate language, and resources for Purum belong under pub, so a dossier here would only duplicate or mix them up.
